description: Details of new and replacement window types with details including glazing bar profiles at 1:2 or 1:1, including any existing context for comparison, detailed sections and showing the context of the existing brick reveal, details of glazing bars and existing and proposed section, detail must be provided which should include timber frames that are in keeping with historic timber profiles found at the building. Drawings must be provided at 1:10 and glazing bar details, details of the dimensions of the ASHP and details of the materiality and treatment of the associated acoustic enclosure in the form of photographs, condition surveys, method statements and details (as specified below) prior to commencing works in relation to the existing condition survey and heritage assessment, and proposed drawings of the rear french door at first floor of the principal building, which must be sympathetic to the special interest of the building and details of any new proposed railings at rear courtyard pursuant to conditions 3, 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8 of planning permission dated 22nd April 2025 (RN:24/05918/FULL)
